Each stall has a different cause and a different first move. Pick the description that sounds like your organisation. Plan Pilot Production 01 The vision is approved. Nothing runs in production. There is a strategy, a vendor shortlist, and possibly a pilot that impressed the board. Between that plan and a working system sits engineering nobody in the building owns. How a workflow reaches production Automated Costly half 02 You automated what you could. The expensive processes resisted. RPA, Zapier, or an off-the-shelf platform covered the simple half. The cross-department workflows that actually cost money were too specific, too multi-step, too dependent on tribal knowledge. How we engineer the hard half Lab Operations 03 You have an AI team. Agents are not reaching the operational floor. Your team knows models. Orchestrating agents in production, keeping them reliable, and wiring them into your existing systems is a different skill set — slow to build from scratch without help.
